chunks: Say: "O people of the Book, why do you reject the word of God when God is a witness to all that you do?"
ai.seo_question: Why does the Quran address the People of the Book with the question 'Why do you reject the signs of God?'
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Aal--Imran, this verse challenges the People of the Book for rejecting divine signs despite their scriptural heritage, highlighting the Shia emphasis on the continuity of revelation. It underscores God's role as the ultimate witness (Shahid) to human deeds, reinforcing the concept of divine justice and accountability central to Shia theology.
